Definition: Calneh or Calno, a place in the Assyrian empire
BiblicalUsage: Calneh is a city of the ancient empires — named among the cities of Nimrod's kingdom, and held up by the prophets as a warning to complacent Israel. Go to Calneh and see, says Amos, whether your kingdom is better than theirs; and Isaiah asks whether Calneh is not as Carchemish, and whether its gods saved it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Calneh is a warning to any nation that trusts its walls: the cities of Nimrod fell, and the cities of Israel fell too, and only the city God builds stands.
